question: Should OpenClaw continue reviewing #95339 as the dashboard/chat landing path, or require the staged modular-dashboard path tracked in #101093 instead?
rationale: The branch is a large product-surface change with protocol, workflow, proof, and approval-boundary blockers, while a newer staged implementation track exists but is not yet merged or fully cleared.

options.title: Prefer staged dashboard track
options.body: Continue product/security review on #101093 and its staged PRs, using #95339 only as historical context unless maintainers explicitly sponsor the big-bang branch.

options.title: Sponsor #95339 after fixes
options.body: Keep #95339 as the target but require the changelog, task-flow protocol, proof, rebase, and owner-review blockers to be resolved before merge review resumes.

options.title: Defer the dashboard direction
options.body: Pause or close the dashboard work if maintainers decide this bundled dashboard/chat surface is not current roadmap scope.

recommendation.title: Prefer staged dashboard track
recommendation.body: Continue product/security review on #101093 and its staged PRs, using #95339 only as historical context unless maintainers explicitly sponsor the big-bang branch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history signal across the Control UI and gateway surfaces plus the product-routing decision this branch needs.
